purpose: Public measured datasets that CONSTRAIN the model in inputs/Q020_model.py (BT-HX-Q020, 4-compartment capillary-interstitium-lymph). This file is a source register, not a new model.
verdict_rule: 'constrains' = an individually measured value in a retrievable file that bounds a model parameter or output. 'proxy_only' = related but not the modelled quantity; NOT counted as a constraint. 'no_open_dataset' = parameter constrained by published literature only.
download_verification: every 'access' field of class 'open-verified' was confirmed by an actual HTTP request returning 200/206 without credentials; sizes are the served Content-Length / on-disk bytes, not quotes from a landing page

sources.title: NHANES 2017-2018 Standard Biochemistry Profile (BIOPRO_J)
sources.license: US federal government work (CDC/NCHS); no copyright, no registration, no login
sources.size_total_dataset: 6 files xpt, 2.1 MB for this one
sources.format: SAS XPORT v5 (.xpt); one row per examined participant, key SEQN; measured on Roche Cobas 6000 (c501)
sources.subjects_note: examined participants aged >=12 y, 2017-2018 US MEC sample; 5905 have a non-missing LBDSALSI
sources.coordinate_frame: N/A - tabular laboratory data, no spatial component

measured.result: 40.0 g/L lies inside the measured [34.0, 47.0] g/L -> CONSISTENT

sources.guards: LBDSTPSI (total protein) p50 = 72.0 g/L vs albumin p50 = 41.0 g/L. The model parameter is ALBUMIN. Feeding total protein would be a 1.75x error and would inflate pi_p by the same factor; both variables sit in the same file, so this mistake is data-checkable.
sources.caveat: CDC's own bridging study: 2017-2018 Roche Cobas 6000 vs 2015-2016 Beckman DxC gives -4.42 %, r=0.968 (non-weighted Deming). Do NOT compare with earlier cycles without that correction.

sources.title: NHANES 1999-2000 Bioelectrical Impedance Analysis (BIX), multi-frequency BIS + Cole modelling
sources.license: US federal government work (CDC/NCHS); no copyright, no registration
sources.format: SAS XPORT v5 (.xpt); Xitron HYDRA ECF/ICF Bio-Impedance Spectrum Analyzer model 4200, 50 log-spaced frequencies 5 kHz-1 MHz, raw R and X stored per frequency; volumes derived by CDC from Cole-model fit + Hanai dielectric mixture theory
sources.subjects_note: eligible ages 8-49 y; BIA completed n=4269; volume variables present for n=4083; after the file's own quality filter (BIAEXSTS==1, BIDFIT<=2) and RIDAGEYR>=18: n=1985 used here
sources.coordinate_frame: N/A - impedance is a scalar body-level measurement; electrode geometry (right hand/foot injection, adjacent sense electrodes) is fixed by protocol, not a 3-D frame
sources.constraint_strength: direct for the water SUMS; the plasma/interstitium split is NOT identifiable

ICF.note: the model's 0.400 L/kg is 39% above the measured median and sits on the p97.5 edge

TBW.note: the model's 0.600 L/kg (42 L at 70 kg) is 19% above the measured median

sources.finding: All three water sums are technically inside [p2.5, p97.5], but the model systematically over-allocates water: TBW +19% and ICF +39% vs the measured medians. The model's 42 L total water for a 70 kg adult sits near the 95th percentile of a 1985-person measured sample.
sources.caveat: CDC's own wording: FFM prediction is 'second order' and percent fat 'third order'; ECF/TBW are Hanai-mixture estimates, not dilution studies. BIA cannot separate plasma from interstitium, so the 0.043 / 0.157 L/kg split inside ECF is unverified by this dataset.

sources.title: NHANES 1999-2000 Body Measures (BMX)
sources.license: US federal government work (CDC/NCHS); no copyright
constrains: denominator for the L/kg conversions of NHANES-BIX

sources.title: NHANES 1999-2000 Blood Pressure (BPX), oscillometric
sources.license: US federal government work (CDC/NCHS); no copyright
sources.format: SAS XPORT v5 (.xpt), 3-4 readings per arm, key SEQN
sources.coordinate_frame: N/A - cuff pressure, no spatial component
sources.prereg_test: D5 asked whether Pc_cap = 20.0 mmHg lies inside [p2.5, p97.5] of measured arterial MAP. It does NOT (20 < 60.7). D5 FAILS.
sources.why_the_test_was_bad: Pc_cap is a CAPILLARY pressure; NHANES measures BRACHIAL ARTERIAL pressure. A capillary/arterial ratio is needed to convert, and no open dataset providing it was found. The test as pre-registered compares quantities that differ by roughly a factor of four. The failure is reported as a failure; it invalidates the test, not the model.

sources.title: NHANES 1999-2000 Demographics (DEMO)
sources.license: US federal government work (CDC/NCHS); no copyright

sources.title: PhysioNet Sleep-EDF Database Expanded v1.0.0
sources.license: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0
sources.size_total_dataset: 8.1 GB uncompressed (197 PSG + 197 hypnograms + 2 subject spreadsheets)
sources.format: EDF (European Data Format) / EDF+; 16-bit signed int, 1 header record (256 B) + 7 signal-header records (2048 B) + data records of 30 s; 2830 data records = 23.58 h
sources.header_layout_note: This file uses the BLOCKED header variant (all labels, then all transducer fields, then all dimensions, ...) rather than the common 256-B-per-signal interleave. The parser auto-detects; reading it as interleaved silently yields wrong numbers.
sources.subjects_note: 153 SC files (sleep-cassette study, 1987-1991, healthy Caucasian adults 25-101 y, ~20 h each) + 44 ST files (sleep-telemetry, 1994, 22 subjects, temazepam/placebo)
sources.coordinate_frame: Signal-wise sensor positions only: EEG at Fpz-Cz and Pz-Oz (10-20 scalp system), EOG horizontal (lateral canthus), chin EMG (submental), oro-nasal airflow (nasal thermistor), RECTAL core temperature (rectal probe). The file carries NO rigid 3-D anatomical coordinate system and no subject-specific landmarks; 'position' is a sensor label.
sources.prereg_test: D6 asked whether 37.0 degC lies inside [p1, p99] of measured rectal temperature. It does (36.34 - 37.94). PASS.
sources.note: A single subject, one night. It confirms the model's fixed 310 K is inside the measured diurnal range of a healthy adult; it says nothing about febrile or shocked patients, i.e. it does not cover the states the model is used for.

sources.title: The Cancer Imaging Archive - LIDC-IDRI
sources.access: open-verified (landing page HTTP 200) but NOT USED
sources.size: ~120 GB total, DICOM CT + derived NIfTI
sources.format: DICOM (LPS patient coordinate system, mm, RescaleIntercept -1024 / slope 1 HU) and NIfTI
sources.why_rejected: The brief asks for geometry/anatomy datasets that constrain THIS model. LIDC-IDRI is lung-nodule CT: it constrains no parameter and no output of a capillary-interstitium-lymph fluid model. Listed here so the rejection is on record rather than silent. This is the honest answer for the 'geometry/anatomy' category: no public anatomical dataset constrains this model, because the model's only anatomical inputs are three scalar volumes (V_plasma0, V_isc0, V_cell0) and one scalar capillary area (A_cap), and no open dataset measures any of them anatomically.

sources.title: Osteoarthritis Initiative (OAI)
sources.access: requires-application (NDA data use agreement) - NOT accessible in this sandbox
sources.format: DICOM knee MRI + clinical tabular, annual visits
constrains: model OUTPUT dV_isc_L (edema volume) and its time course t90_h
R_ret_mg_mL via effusion vs serum albumin pairs
sources.why_it_matters: OAI is longitudinally sampled (8 annual visits) and contains reader-graded KNEE JOINT EFFUSION, i.e. a directly measured swelling volume on the same anatomical scale (mL) as the model's primary output. It is the single most promising route to validating the model's OUTPUT. It is listed as a gap, not as a result.

sources.title: PhysioNet MIMIC-IV / eICU-CRD
sources.access: credentialed (DUA + CITI DataShare training) - NOT accessible in this sandbox
sources.subjects: MIMIC-IV ~65k adult ICU stays; eICU ~200k stays
constrains: model OUTPUT dV_isc_L as a per-patient fluid balance time series
c_plasma (serum albumin lab values) paired with cumulative intake/output
sources.why_it_matters: The only realistic public-adjacent source of a per-patient fluid-balance time series against which the model's transient (t90, tau_l, tau_hep) could be fitted. Blocked by credentials in this environment; recorded as a gap.

parameters_with_no_open_dataset.statement: For the following 31 of 34 parameters in inputs/Q020_model.py PARAMS, no public per-subject measured dataset was located. They are constrained by published literature values only, i.e. they are NOT independently verifiable from open data.

microvascular.literature_anchor: Michel CC, Curry FE. Microvascular permeability. Physiol Rev 1999;79:703-761. doi:10.1152/physrev.1999.79.3.703
microvascular.geometry_note: A_cap = 3000 m^2 is a morphometric estimate. No open human capillary-morphometry dataset (histology, stereology, or in-vivo) was found. This is the model's one true ANATOMICAL/GEOMETRY input and it has no open data source.

interstitium.literature_anchor: Guyton AC, Ackerman DH. Dynamics of interstitial fluid pressure. Circ Res 1965;16:452-460. doi:10.1161/01.res.16.5.452 ; Guyton AC et al. Circ Res 1966;19:412-419. doi:10.1161/01.res.19.2.412 ; subcutaneous interstitial fluid pressure by the wick-in-socket method (Wiig H et al.).
interstitium.critical_gap: c_isc0 = 15 g/L (and hence the assumed c_isc0/c_plasma = 0.38) has NO open dataset. Interstitial (subcutaneous wick) albumin is measured in a handful of small human and isolated-perfusion-tissue studies published as articles only, with no per-subject deposit. Consequence: the albumin-retention branch of the model (J_p, sigma_s, R_ret) rests on an unverified ratio. This is the most consequential single gap in the audit.

lymph.literature_anchor: lymphatic pump in-vitro work (Adair DL, Guyton AC; Humphrey JD et al.)
lymph.statement: No public dataset of human lymph flow, lymph protein concentration, or lymph turnover time was located. The entire lymph half of the model is unconstrained by open data.

hepatic_cellular.statement: M_body is only a scenario definition (70 kg). n_Hill, pi_max and c_half are calibrated to two literature points inside the model file, not measured. tau_hep = 120 min is a regulation timescale, NOT the albumin half-life (~20 d) and no open dataset distinguishes them.

coverage_summary.headline: The model's microvascular and lymphatic halves - which is where all the mechanistic content of Q020 lives - have no open measured dataset at all. Open data pin one parameter (c_plasma), weakly bound three water sums, and one pre-registered test (Pc_cap) failed.
